# Testing the intra-species hourglass model

Statistically test whether the two cell lineages (fusiform & ray lineages) share higher transcriptomic similarity at mid developmental stage.

## Setup

```{r Library}
library(Seurat, quietly = TRUE)
library(slingshot, quietly = TRUE)
library(dtw, quietly = TRUE)
library(sccore, quietly = TRUE)
library(magrittr, quietly = TRUE)
library(Matrix, quietly = TRUE)
library(ggplot2, quietly = TRUE)
library(pheatmap, quietly = TRUE)
library(foreach, quietly = TRUE)
library(doSNOW, quietly = TRUE)
source("notebooks/scripts/hourglass_analysis.R")
source("notebooks/scripts/parallel_processing.R")
```

## Test hourglass along pseudotime

**The procedure:**

1.  Infer pseudotime along cell lineages using Slingshot based on PCA coordinates.

2.  Aggregate expression by pseudotime bins (by `n_bins`).

3.  Calculate pairwise similarity between bins across lineages (using `metric`).

4.  Align cell lineages by bins using a Dynamic Time Wrapping (DTW) algorithm. (using `window_size`)

5.  Calculate the `hourglass score` based on cell lineage alignment.

    Hourglass score is defined as follows:

    Let $S_i$ denote the transcriptomic similarity at aligned pseudotime position $i$, and let $\mathcal{E}$, $\mathcal{M}$, and $\mathcal{L}$ denote the sets of early-, middle-, and late-stage positions, respectively. Stage-specific mean similarities were calculated as

    $$
    E=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{E}|}\sum_{i\in\mathcal{E}}S_i,\qquad
    M=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{M}|}\sum_{i\in\mathcal{M}}S_i,\qquad
    L=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{L}|}\sum_{i\in\mathcal{L}}S_i.
    $$

    The hourglass score was then defined as

    $$
    H=\min\left\{M-E,\;M-L\right\}.
    $$

    A positive score requires the middle-stage similarity to exceed both the early- and late-stage similarities.

6.  Permutation for the null distribution of the hourglass score\

    (1) Shuffle pseudotime defind cell states\
    (2) Repeat Step 2-5\
    (3) Estimate permutation p-value

7.  Bootstrapping for the confidence interval of the hourglass score\

    (1) Re-sample cells with replacement\
    (2) Repeat Step 1-5\
    (3) Estimate bootstrap confidence interval

### 1. Pseudotime inference

Infer Pseudotime using Slingshot based on PCA coordinates

```{r Infer Pseudotime}
slingshot_res <- suppressWarnings(
  slingshot_manual(seurat_obj, lineage_cell_types)
)
# if (grepl("tar", params$sample_id)) {
#   slingshot_res <- slingshot_manual_2(seurat_obj, lineage_cell_types)
# }
pseudotime <- slingshot_res$pseudotime
branch_id <- slingshot_res$branch_id

head(pseudotime)
head(branch_id)
```

```{r Plot Pseudotime}
seurat_obj$pseudotime_all <- rowMeans(pseudotime, na.rm = TRUE)
p_pt <- FeaturePlot(
    seurat_obj,
    features = "pseudotime_all"
  ) + 
  scale_color_viridis_c(
    direction = -1,
    option = "magma"
  ) +
  theme_void(
  )
p_pt + theme(legend.position = "bottom") | p_cluster + theme(legend.position = "none")
```

### 2. Bin expression by pseudotime

Expression was aggregated within equal-width pseudotime bins independently for each lineage.

Fusiform and ray bins were subsequently aligned using a constrained monotonic DTW (Dynamic Time Warping) path.

```{r Bin expression}
n_bins <- params$n_bins

res_L1 <- bin_expression(
  seurat_obj = seurat_obj,
  pseudotime_mtx = pseudotime,
  branch_id = branch_id,
  lineage = 1,
  n_bins = n_bins,
  prefix = "FuIP"
)
res_L2 <- bin_expression(
  seurat_obj = seurat_obj,
  pseudotime_mtx = pseudotime,
  branch_id = branch_id,
  lineage = 2,
  n_bins = n_bins,
  prefix = "Ray"
)

pb_L1 <- res_L1$Pseudobulk
pb_L2 <- res_L2$Pseudobulk
comp_L1 <- res_L1$Composition
comp_L2 <- res_L2$Composition

comp_L2
```

### 3. Pairwise similarity of pseudotime bins

Calculate pairwise similarity among pseudotime bins based on the specified metric.

```{r Calculate similarity across binned pseudotime}
# restrict to highly variable genes expressed among all lineages
genes <- Reduce(intersect, list(
  rownames(pb_L1), rownames(pb_L2)# , rownames(pb_L3)
))
genes <- intersect(genes, VariableFeatures(seurat_obj)) # subset to highly variable genes

# 
similarity_L1 <- calculate_similarity(
  pb_L1[genes, , drop = FALSE], 
  pb_L2[genes, , drop = FALSE], 
  metrics = params$metric,
  norm_func = logcpm
)
```

### 4. Align pseudotime bins

Find the correspondence between lineage pseudotime by the Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) algorithm:

```{r}
print(align_similarity_matrix)
```

Align pseudotime bins

```{r Run align_similarity_matrix}
aligned_L1 <- align_similarity_matrix(
  similarity = similarity_L1 %>% t,
  window_size = ceiling(
    as.numeric(params$window_dtw) * max(dim(similarity_L1))
  ),
  open.begin = params$open.begin,
  open.end = params$open.end
)
S_L1 <- aligned_L1$path$similarity
```

Plot aligned paths

```{r Plot DTW path}
plot_dtw_path <- function(
  similarity,
  aligned,
  title
) {
  similarity <- as.matrix(similarity)

  stopifnot(
    max(aligned$path$L1_i) <= nrow(similarity),
    max(aligned$path$L2_i) <= ncol(similarity)
  )

  heatmap_data <- expand.grid(
    L1_i = seq_len(nrow(similarity)),
    L2_i = seq_len(ncol(similarity))
  )

  heatmap_data$similarity <- similarity[
    cbind(
      heatmap_data$L1_i,
      heatmap_data$L2_i
    )
  ]

  ggplot(
    heatmap_data,
    aes(
      x = L2_i,
      y = L1_i,
      fill = similarity
    )
  ) +
    geom_tile() +
    geom_path(
      data = aligned$path,
      aes(
        x = L2_i,
        y = L1_i
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linewidth = 1
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = aligned$path,
      aes(
        x = L2_i,
        y = L1_i
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 1.5
    ) +
    scale_fill_distiller(
      palette = "RdYlBu", 
      direction = -1
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq_len(ncol(similarity)),
      labels = colnames(similarity),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_y_reverse(
      breaks = seq_len(nrow(similarity)),
      labels = rownames(similarity),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 90,
        hjust = 1,
        vjust = 0.5
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Fusiform reference bin",
      y = "Ray query bin",
      fill = "similarity",
      title = title
    )
}
p_path_L1 <- plot_dtw_path(
  similarity = t(similarity_L1),
  aligned = aligned_L1,
  title = "Ray vs Fusiform-FuIP DTW alignment\n(%s)" %>% sprintf(params$metric)
)

save_fig(
```

```{r Plot simialrity along the alinged path}
    ymin = min(aligned_L1$path$similarity, na.rm = TRUE),
    ymax = max(aligned_L1$path$similarity, na.rm = TRUE),
    alpha = 0.2,
    fill = "purple"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 1)
  ) +
  labs(
      x = "Pseudotime bin",
      y = sprintf("Transcriptomic similarity (%s)", params$metric)
  )

save_fig(

  file = file.path(
    params$path_debug_figure,
    sprintf("aligned_similarity_%s_%s.svg", params$sample_id, params$metric)
```

### 5. Calculate hourglass score

Hourglass score is defined as follows:

Let $S_i$ denote the transcriptomic similarity at aligned pseudotime position $i$, and let $\mathcal{E}$, $\mathcal{M}$, and $\mathcal{L}$ denote the sets of early-, middle-, and late-stage positions, respectively. Stage-specific mean similarities were calculated as

$$
E=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{E}|}\sum_{i\in\mathcal{E}}S_i,\qquad
M=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{M}|}\sum_{i\in\mathcal{M}}S_i,\qquad
L=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{L}|}\sum_{i\in\mathcal{L}}S_i.
$$

The hourglass score was then defined as

$$
H=\min\left\{M-E,\;M-L\right\}.
$$

A positive score requires the middle-stage similarity to exceed both the early- and late-stage similarities.

```{r Define function for calculating hourglass scores}
print(hourglass_score)
```

```{r Calculate the hourglass score}
scores_observed <- rbind(
  hourglass_score(aligned_L1$path, modules)
) %>% 
  as.data.frame %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    comparison = c("FuIP-Ray"),
    permutation = "Observed"
  )

scores_observed
```

Calculate the permutation p-value

```{r Calculate the permutation p-value}
observed_H <- scores_observed %>%
  dplyr::select(
    comparison,
    H_obs = H
  )

permutation_results <- scores_perm %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is.finite(H)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    permutation,
    comparison,
    H_perm = H
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    observed_H,
    by = "comparison"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(comparison) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    H_obs = dplyr::first(H_obs),
    n_permutation = dplyr::n_distinct(permutation),
    n_null_ge_observed = sum(H_perm >= dplyr::first(H_obs)),
    null_mean = mean(H_perm),
    null_median = median(H_perm),
    null_sd = stats::sd(H_perm),
    null_q025 = unname(stats::quantile(H_perm, 0.025)),
    null_q95 = unname(stats::quantile(H_perm, 0.95)),
    null_q975 = unname(stats::quantile(H_perm, 0.975)),
    observed_minus_null_mean = dplyr::first(H_obs) - mean(H_perm),
    observed_percentile = mean(H_perm < dplyr::first(H_obs)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    # One-sided empirical permutation P value
    p_empirical = (n_null_ge_observed + 1) / (n_permutation + 1),
    # Adjust p-value
    p_holm = stats::p.adjust(p_empirical, method = "holm")
  )
```

### 7. Bootstrapping

Re-sample cells with replacement, repeat the procedure for estimating the hourglass score, and calculate the confidence interval of the hourglass score.

```{r Define bootstrapping helper functions}
print(make_bootstrap_seurat)
```

```{r Define bootstrap runner function}
run_bootstrap_once <- function(seed) {
  # Encourage R to release the large temporary Seurat objects
  # after this replicate finishes.
  on.exit(gc(), add = TRUE)

  tryCatch(
    {
      source("notebooks/scripts/hourglass_analysis.R")
      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      # 1. Uniformly resample cells and retain published labels
      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      resampling_i <- make_bootstrap_seurat(
        seurat_obj = seurat_obj,
        seed = seed
      )
      seurat_obj_i <- resampling_i$object

      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      # 2. Repeat the same preprocessing procedure
      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      seurat_obj_i <- NormalizeData(seurat_obj_i, verbose = FALSE)
      seurat_obj_i <- FindVariableFeatures(seurat_obj_i, verbose = FALSE)
      seurat_obj_i <- ScaleData(
        seurat_obj_i,
        features = VariableFeatures(seurat_obj_i),
        verbose = FALSE
      )
      seurat_obj_i <- RunPCA(seurat_obj_i, npcs = 30, verbose = FALSE)

      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      # 3. Re-estimate pseudotime
      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      slingshot_res_i <- suppressWarnings(
        slingshot_manual(seurat_obj_i, lineage_cell_types)
      )

      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      # 4. Reconstruct lineage pseudobulks
      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      res_L1_i <- bin_expression(
        seurat_obj = seurat_obj_i,
        pseudotime_mtx = slingshot_res_i$pseudotime,
        branch_id = slingshot_res_i$branch_id,
        lineage = 1,
        n_bins = n_bins,
        prefix = "Fusiform"
      )
      res_L2_i <- bin_expression(
        seurat_obj = seurat_obj_i,
        pseudotime_mtx = slingshot_res_i$pseudotime,
        branch_id = slingshot_res_i$branch_id,
        lineage = 2,
        n_bins = n_bins,
        prefix = "Ray"
      )
      pb_L1_i <- res_L1_i$Pseudobulk
      pb_L2_i <- res_L2_i$Pseudobulk
      comp_L1_i <- res_L1_i$Composition
      comp_L2_i <- res_L2_i$Composition

      minimum_reference_bins <- 3L
      if (
        ncol(pb_L1_i) < minimum_reference_bins ||
        ncol(pb_L2_i) < minimum_reference_bins
      ) {
        stop("Too few occupied fusiform reference bins for DTW.")
      }

      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      # 5. Identify the middle Ray stage
      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      modules_i <- get_middle_module(
        pb_mat = pb_L2_i, 
        comp = comp_L2_i,
        cell_types = "Ray Precursor",
        cell_type_marker = species_marker, 
        n_bins = params$window_mid
      )

      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      # 6. Select genes for this end-to-end bootstrap replicate
      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      genes_i <- Reduce(
        intersect,
        list(
          rownames(pb_L1_i),
          rownames(pb_L2_i)
        )
      )
      genes_i <- intersect(
        genes_i,
        VariableFeatures(seurat_obj_i)
      )
      if (length(genes_i) < 2L) {
        stop("Too few variable genes remained.")
      }

      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      # 7. Calculate transcriptomic similarity
      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      similarity_L1_i <- calculate_similarity(
        pb_L1_i[genes_i, , drop = FALSE],
        pb_L2_i[genes_i, , drop = FALSE],
        metrics = metric
      )

      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      # 8. Re-estimate DTW alignments
      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      aligned_L1_i <- align_similarity_matrix(
        t(similarity_L1_i),
        window_size = ceiling(
          as.numeric(params$window_dtw) * max(dim(similarity_L1_i))
        ),
        open.begin = params$open.begin,
        open.end = params$open.end
      )

      # report cell state alignment 
      alignment_mass_L1_i <- alignment_label_mass(
        aligned = aligned_L1_i,
        comp_query = comp_L2_i,
        comp_reference = comp_L1_i,
        query_states = ray_lineage,
        reference_states = fusiform_lineage
      )


      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      # 9. Calculate bootstrap hourglass scores
      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      score_matrix <- rbind(
        hourglass_score(
          aligned_L1_i$path,
          modules_i
        )
      )
      scores <- data.frame(
        score_matrix,
        comparison = c(
          "FuIP-Ray"
        ),
        bootstrap = seed,
        row.names = NULL,
        check.names = FALSE
      )
      list(
        ok = TRUE,
        seed = seed,
        scores = scores,
        alignment_mass = list(
          `FuIP-Ray` = alignment_mass_L1_i
        ),
        error = NA_character_
      )
    },
    error = function(e) {
      list(
        ok = FALSE,
        seed = seed,
        scores = NULL,
        alignment_mass = NULL,
        error = conditionMessage(e)
      )
    }
  )
}
```

```{r}
summarize_alignment_mass <- function(
    bootstrap_output,
    bootstrap_ok,
    comparison
) {
  mass_list <- lapply(
    bootstrap_output[bootstrap_ok],
    function(x) {
      x$alignment_mass[[comparison]]
    }
  )
  mass_array <- simplify2array(mass_list)

  list(
    mean = apply(mass_array, c(1, 2), mean),
    median = apply(mass_array, c(1, 2), median),
    lower = apply(mass_array, c(1, 2), stats::quantile, probs = 0.025),
    upper = apply(mass_array,c(1, 2), stats::quantile, probs = 0.975),
    array = mass_array
  )
}
```

Calculate confidence interval

```{r Calculate confidence interval}
scores_observed_ci <- scores_observed %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    M_minus_E = Middle - Early,
    M_minus_L = Middle - Late
  )

scores_bootstrap_ci <- scores_bootstrap %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    M_minus_E = Middle - Early,
    M_minus_L = Middle - Late
  )

bootstrap_ci <- scores_bootstrap_ci %>%
  dplyr::group_by(comparison) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_bootstrap = dplyr::n_distinct(bootstrap),

    H_median = median(H, na.rm = TRUE),
    H_ci_lower = unname(quantile(H, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
    H_ci_upper = unname(quantile(H, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),

    M_minus_E_median = median(M_minus_E, na.rm = TRUE),
    M_minus_E_ci_lower = unname(quantile(M_minus_E, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
    M_minus_E_ci_upper = unname(quantile(M_minus_E, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),

    M_minus_L_median = median(M_minus_L, na.rm = TRUE),
    M_minus_L_ci_lower = unname(quantile(M_minus_L, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
    M_minus_L_ci_upper = unname(quantile(M_minus_L, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    scores_observed_ci %>%
      dplyr::select(
        comparison,
        H_observed = H,
        M_minus_E_observed = M_minus_E,
        M_minus_L_observed = M_minus_L
      ),
    by = "comparison"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    comparison,
    H_observed,
    H_median,
    H_ci_lower,
    H_ci_upper,
    M_minus_E_observed,
    M_minus_E_ci_lower,
    M_minus_E_ci_upper,
    M_minus_L_observed,
    M_minus_L_ci_lower,
    M_minus_L_ci_upper,
    n_bootstrap
  )
```

```{r Plot bootstrap hourglass scores}
    title = NULL,
    subtitle = sprintf("Observed H: %.2f", scores_observed$H),
    caption = sprintf("CI: %.2f-%.2f", bootstrap_ci$H_ci_lower, bootstrap_ci$H_ci_upper)
  )

save_fig(
  p_bootstrap_H,
  file = file.path(
    params$path_debug_figure,
    sprintf("bootstrap_H_%s_%s.svg", params$sample_id, params$metric) 
  ),
  height = 4,
  width = 5
)

p_bootstrap_H
```

## Write key data

Write one long CSV containing the observed scores and the complete permutation and bootstrap distributions. This file is the input for `Intra-species-hourglass-bio-aggregated.Rmd`.

```{r Prepare key data}
sample_metadata <- list(
  sample_id = params$sample_id,
  individual_id = params$individual_id,
  condition = params$condition,
  batch = params$batch
)

observed_key <- scores_observed %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    data_type = "observed",
    replicate_id = "Observed",
    seed = NA_integer_,
    comparison,
    Early,
    Middle,
    Late,
    H
  )

permutation_key <- scores_perm %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    data_type = "permutation",
    replicate_id = permutation,
    seed = as.integer(seed),
    comparison,
    Early,
    Middle,
    Late,
    H
  )

bootstrap_key <- scores_bootstrap %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    data_type = "bootstrap",
    replicate_id = paste0("Bootstrap-", bootstrap),
    seed = as.integer(bootstrap),
    comparison,
    Early,
    Middle,
    Late,
    H
  )

key_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  observed_key,
  permutation_key,
  bootstrap_key,
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sample_id = sample_metadata$sample_id,
    individual_id = sample_metadata$individual_id,
    condition = sample_metadata$condition,
    batch = sample_metadata$batch,
    metric = as.character(params$metric),
    M_minus_E = Middle - Early,
    M_minus_L = Middle - Late,
    n_cells = ncol(seurat_obj),
    n_genes = length(genes),
    n_bins = n_bins,
    n_permutation = n_permutation,
    n_bootstrap_requested = n_bootstrap,
    n_bootstrap_valid = sum(bootstrap_ok),
    n_bootstrap_failed = sum(!bootstrap_ok)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sample_id,
    individual_id,
    condition,
    batch,
    metric,
    data_type,
    replicate_id,
    seed,
    comparison,
    Early,
    Middle,
    Late,
    M_minus_E,
    M_minus_L,
    H,
    n_cells,
    n_genes,
    n_bins,
    n_permutation,
    n_bootstrap_requested,
    n_bootstrap_valid,
    n_bootstrap_failed
  )

head(key_data)
```

Write a concise sample-level summary in addition to the complete long table.

```{r Prepare key summary}
branch_key_summary <- scores_observed_ci %>%
  dplyr::select(
    comparison,
    Early,
    Middle,
    Late,
    H_observed = H,
    M_minus_E_observed = M_minus_E,
    M_minus_L_observed = M_minus_L
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    permutation_results %>%
      dplyr::select(
        comparison,
        p_permutation = p_empirical,
        p_holm,
        null_mean,
        null_sd
      ),
    by = "comparison"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    bootstrap_ci %>%
      dplyr::select(
        comparison,
        H_bootstrap_median = H_median,
        H_ci_lower,
        H_ci_upper,
        n_bootstrap
      ),
    by = "comparison"
  )


key_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  branch_key_summary,
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sample_id = sample_metadata$sample_id,
    individual_id = sample_metadata$individual_id,
    condition = sample_metadata$condition,
    batch = sample_metadata$batch,
    metric = as.character(params$metric),
    n_cells = ncol(seurat_obj),
    n_genes = length(genes),
    n_bins = n_bins,
    n_permutation = n_permutation,
    n_bootstrap_requested = n_bootstrap,
    n_bootstrap_valid = sum(bootstrap_ok),
    n_bootstrap_failed = sum(!bootstrap_ok)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sample_id,
    individual_id,
    condition,
    batch,
    metric,
    comparison,
    Early,
    Middle,
    Late,
    M_minus_E_observed,
    M_minus_L_observed,
    H_observed,
    p_permutation,
    p_holm,
    null_mean,
    null_sd,
    H_bootstrap_median,
    H_ci_lower,
    H_ci_upper,
    n_cells,
    n_genes,
    n_bins,
    n_permutation,
    n_bootstrap_requested,
    n_bootstrap_valid,
    n_bootstrap_failed
  )

key_summary
```

```{r Write key data CSVs}
dir.create(
  dirname(params$path_key_data),
  showWarnings = FALSE,
  recursive = TRUE
)
dir.create(
  dirname(params$path_key_summary),
  showWarnings = FALSE,
  recursive = TRUE
)

write.csv(
  key_data,
  file = params$path_key_data,
  row.names = FALSE,
  quote = TRUE
)
write.csv(
  key_summary,
  file = params$path_key_summary,
  row.names = FALSE,
  quote = TRUE
)
```
